purpose: Central inventory for ChatGPT development integrations and external verification runners. Status values are an operator-maintained snapshot, not a live API probe.

integrations.name: GitHub
integrations.notes: Use feature branches and PRs. Do not push directly to protected release branches.

integrations.name: Vercel
integrations.notes: Prefer preview/staging first. Production promotion is an approval gate.

integrations.name: Railway
integrations.notes: Do not apply production changes until database migrations and health checks pass.

integrations.name: Supabase
integrations.notes: Back up and review migrations; never expose service-role credentials to client code.

integrations.name: Higgsfield / 3D Jutsu
integrations.notes: Some image/video generation actions may consume credits. Verify the exported asset in the target renderer.

integrations.name: OpenArt
integrations.notes: Generated images are references, not production-ready meshes by default.

integrations.name: Superpowers
integrations.connectionAction: Connect the app from ChatGPT's app/plugin connection flow.

integrations.connectionAction: Connect the app from ChatGPT's app/plugin connection flow.

integrations.name: Codex Security
integrations.connectionAction: Connect the app from ChatGPT's app/plugin connection flow.
integrations.notes: A security scan is one signal; it does not prove an APK is spyware-free.

integrations.name: PostHog
integrations.connectionAction: Connect the app from ChatGPT's app/plugin connection flow.

integrations.name: Replit
integrations.notes: Optional; do not fork or replace the canonical Android/game repositories for a quick prototype.

integrations.name: Ramus remote diagnostics / test runner
integrations.notes: External runner, not a ChatGPT plugin connection. A step is complete only when logs or evidence are returned and inspected.
